Definition: of uncertain derivation; depressed, i.e. (figuratively) humiliated (in circumstances or disposition):--base, cast down, humble, of low degree (estate), lowly.
BiblicalUsage: Jesus says, learn of Me, for I am meek and lowly in heart, and ye shall find rest unto your souls. Mary sings that God hath put down the mighty from their seats and exalted them of low degree. James says God giveth more grace, and Paul tells the Romans to condescend to men of low estate.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe the lowly are not overlooked by God; the Lord Himself is lowly in heart, and He lifts the lowly up. My position is that resting in Christ means learning His lowliness, not chasing a higher place.
